verdict.rationale: The source is public in the github.com/grafana/grafana repository, and community discussion confirms Grafana moved to the AGPLv3 open-source license. First-party docs also describe Grafana OSS and a self-managed open source MCP server. missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license terms (e.g. a LICENSE file or licensing docs page), and clarity on which components (OSS vs Enterprise/Cloud) are covered by the open license.
